title: Candice Status Event
description: Real project/session state published to the Candice Companion, one event per source state. Progress is never invented: only state that actually exists in the Claude session or the invoked skill is reported. Candice Master Spec section 16. Version: 1.0.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this event schema. Bumped by the integration/release owner only (manifest 9.4 class 2).

sessionId.description: Opaque session id the status belongs to. Status events from an unknown session are ignored; host-window placement is never session identity.

event.description: Event discriminator for the shared envelope.

phase.description: The companion's display state, driven only by real skill/session state. TEXT_FALLBACK means the companion is unavailable and the session is in Claude text mode; failure never stops Claude.

message.description: Human-readable status line, also shown as a caption.

captions.description: Captions are always shown regardless of voice-output state; the field records whether this event carries a caption for accessibility.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp supplied by the caller. Never generated inside the companion runtime.

detail.description: Optional extension fields (e.g. progress counts) with no schema obligation beyond being JSON. Never used to invent progress.
